messages:
alex: Heads-up — post-launch follow-up sync. Metrics this morning show a spike in 500s on the embed pipeline and a handful of customers reporting degraded quality on long-context prompts. We need a quick grooming to decide mini-sprint scope: hard-fix hotbugs vs a small UX/quality polish.

maria: Can you paste the error slices?

alex: Sure — 80% of 5xx from /v1/embeddings, tail at p99 tokenization timeouts. Sample log: ```ERROR [embed-worker] request_id=abc123 timeout at token_conv (2000ms) stack=...```

devon: Tokenizer timeouts smell like a batching/buffer edge on the dedicated pool. I can run a profiling pass today. If it's batching, cheap fix.

sasha: Customer quality reports are from the new long-context reranker — appears behavior difference vs model baseline. Might be a prompt/regression not infra.

jen: We should split scope: 1) infra stability (5xx + tokenization) as P0, 2) reranker quality investigation as P1, 3) small UX polish (streaming indicator) as P2. Agree? :+1:

alex: Agree. Proposal: 3-day mini-sprint focused on P0 (fix + canary), P1 investigation with a rollback decision on day 3, P2 deferred unless quick.

maria: Who owns P0? devon?

devon: I can own P0. Plan: repro in staging, add extra logging, try disabling continuous batching as a toggle, then canary.

sasha: I'll pair on P1. I'll run diff evals on the reranker prompts against the GA baseline and flag regressions.

jen: Tests to run: end-to-end on sample customers (cohort A), perf suite for embeddings, and synthetic long contexts. I can coordinate QA.

alex: Timeline: Day0 (today) — triage + assign. Day1 — fix + staging canary. Day2 — monitor + rollback readiness. Day3 — rollout decision and postmortem. Does that sound tight enough?

maria: Tight but OK. Add an action to update the runbook with rollback criteria.

devon: Action: PR for extra logging + `BATCH_DISABLE=true` toggle by EOD. I’ll post the link.

sasha: Action: eval harness + prompt set diff by EOD tomorrow.

jen: QA action: run the three test suites, annotate any customer-impacting diffs, and freeze P2 changes.

alex: For communication: I'll ping customers in the affected cohort with a brief PSA and expected timeline. deploy-bot: schedule canary window at 10:30 PST?

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled for 1745560200 — rolling to 10% of dedicated pool.

maria: One more tradeoff note — if the tokenization fix increases per-token latency by >5% we may not push global rollout; need cost/latency tradeoff eval in decision criteria.

alex: Good call. Decision checklist: reduces 5xx to <1% of baseline, p99 latency delta <= +5%, no major quality regression visible in reranker diffs. If all pass -> rollout. If infra fixed but quality fails -> rollback model variant to GA for reranker.

devon: I'll update the PR with perf numbers in staging.

sasha: I'll produce a short doc with failing prompt examples for eng and SEs.

jen: Noted — I'll coordinate a short postmortem thread after Day3 regardless.

alex: OK — owners set, actions assigned. Quick sync at 09:00 tomorrow to check progress. Thanks everyone :rocket:
